candidates.title: Collective Effects near the Ion Space-Charge Limit of the Orbitron (APS DPP 2024)
candidates.notes: Publicly accessible APS abstract. Reports 'negative mass' instabilities limiting ion density to ~1 order of magnitude below theoretical space-charge limit. Relevant to space-charge mitigation physics that underpins the 100 kV→300 kV scaling story. Minimal quantitative data but confirms 2024 experimental progress and identifies the density-limiting mechanism.

candidates.title: Ion Constants of Motion in the Orbitron Fusion Device (APS DPP 2024)
candidates.notes: Theoretical/computational abstract by Johan Carlsson. Describes Hamilton-Jacobi separability and action variables for Orbitron confinement. No quantitative measurements or scaling data. Not extracted.

candidates.title: Mode-enhanced ion loading in a 100 kV orbitrap — Physics of Plasmas (2025)
candidates.notes: Primary source for G-11. No preprint on arXiv or OSTI (DOE funding not confirmed for this specific paper). Authors: Daniel Merthe, Sahel Hakimi et al. Cannot be obtained from public sources.
